title: 一对多借阅
objective: 连接一对多的两张表，理解明细展开带来的行数变化。
statement: 连接 borrow_records 与 books，按 borrow_records.book_id = books.id 配对。依次输出 record_id（借阅记录编号）、title（书名），每次借阅一行。同一本书被借多次时分别输出；未被借过的图书不输出。不要求行顺序。
knowledge: 一本书可以有多条借阅记录，因此书名可能在连接结果中出现多次。每行代表一次借阅，不应合并。
borrow_records.book_id 引用 books.id。本例外键非空，每条借阅恰好匹配一本书。
INNER JOIN 只输出匹配行，没有借阅记录的图书不会出现。
starterSql: -- 输出每次借阅的记录编号与书名。

flowchart.exampleSql: SELECT br.id AS record_id, b.title AS title FROM borrow_records AS br JOIN books AS b ON br.book_id = b.id;

nodes.label: 从明细连接书目
nodes.description: 每次借阅匹配一本书，结果仍是每条借阅一行。

nodes.label:
从哪边出发？
FROM borrow_records
nodes.description: 每条借阅记录都要出现在结果里；从明细表出发，逐条寻找它的书。

nodes.label:
怎么配对？
ON br.book_id = b.id
nodes.description: 明细行的 book_id 等于书目行的 id 时配对；借阅记录不会悬空。

nodes.label:
行数怎么变？
一本书多行
nodes.description: 同一本书被借多次，书名就重复多次；重复的是书名，借阅记录编号各不相同。

nodes.label:
没借出的书呢？
不出现
nodes.description: 内连接按明细展开；没有借阅记录的图书没有行，结果里看不到它。

nodes.label:
输出什么？
record_id 与 title
nodes.description: 一行一条借阅：记录编号加书名；不要按书去重。

hints.text: 从借阅明细出发连接书目表：每条借阅一行，重复的书名是明细展开，不要去重。
FROM borrow_records AS br JOIN books AS b ON br.book_id = b.id; 用别名引用两表的列。
SELECT br.id AS record_id, b.title AS title FROM borrow_records AS br JOIN books AS b ON ____;

referenceSolutions.sql: SELECT br.id AS record_id, b.title AS title FROM borrow_records AS br JOIN books AS b ON br.book_id = b.id;
referenceSolutions.explanation: 从借阅明细出发按外键配对书目；每次借阅输出一行，书名随明细重复，未借出的图书不出现。

expectedFailures.sql: SELECT DISTINCT b.title AS title FROM borrow_records AS br JOIN books AS b ON br.book_id = b.id;
SELECT b.title AS title, br.id AS record_id FROM borrow_records AS br JOIN books AS b ON br.book_id = b.id GROUP BY b.title;
SELECT br.id AS record_id, b.title AS title FROM borrow_records AS br JOIN books AS b ON br.book_id = b.id WHERE br.returned_on IS NOT NULL;
SELECT b.title AS title FROM borrow_records AS br JOIN books AS b ON br.book_id = b.id;
